description: Read a text file from the project and return its contents with line numbers, or view a PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image, downscaled to fit and returned whole. Output starts with a header showing the line range and total line count. A read stops early at the line limit or output byte budget; continue with offset. Prefer this over shell commands such as cat, sed, head, or tail for reading files.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project directory

offset.description: First line to read, counting from 1

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return
